verification.summary: The spec 002 implementation (mock-github server, terminal repaint/snapshot markers, comment endpoints, proactive tracker dedup) was already built and manually verified working correctly against the contract. The ACCS itself is critically broken: its check_snapshots() awk function never initializes lastN, so awk's implicit numeric-0 default makes the very first snapshot marker (n=0, which is correct) always fail as 'nonmonotonic', on every phase, for any implementation. I also fixed one stale test asserting the pre-port-change default of 4000 instead of 4123.

mustFix.quote: if (n<=lastN) { print "FAIL nonmonotonic " n " after " lastN; bad=1; exit }
mustFix.problem: lastN is never initialized (no BEGIN block), so awk treats it as numeric 0. Since snapshot numbering correctly starts at 0 per the enriched contract, the very first marker line always satisfies n<=lastN (0<=0) and the script exits FAIL immediately, before any real assertion runs. Reproduced in isolation with a two-line synthetic snippet (no server involved): 'FAIL nonmonotonic 0 after '. This means check_snapshots(), called in every phase of accs.bash, can never succeed regardless of what src/ implements.
